style: Avant-garde ensemble folk-punk fusion. Quartal suspended chord fields with bitonal friction. Melodic contour: angular consonant-heavy patter runs with rising terminal pitch contours, microtonal inflections, and sudden leaps. Rhythmic physics: 3:2 asymmetric polyrhythm over a shared six-pulse substrate, driven by chest percussion, stomping boots, and dense finger-snap lattices. Timbre: hammered santur and cimbalom, circuit-bent toy electronics glitches, dry close-miked separation, mridangam, pandeiro, cuíca squeals, ngoni, and kora with high metallic chrome shine. Performance attitude: nervous, hyper-articulate, deadpan precise with communal infection. Production: dry separation, exposure windows, morse radio link transmission, tape flutter, spring reverb echoes, and feedback runaway thresholds. Acoustic environment maps directly to internal psychological decay rates.
lyrics:
[Intro: Morse Radio Link and Chest Percussion]
[Transmission 01: Unknown Rescuer Beacon]
[Mridangam and Pandeiro 3:2 Pulse Lock]
[Circuit-Bent Toy Glitch Bursts]

[Verse 1: Spoken-Sung Patter Burst]
Being in The Stuff is nasty,
Every heavy particle is tacky,
Sticky ooze of damp material space,
Stuck forever in a meaningless place!
Time is stupid, clock is leaden,
Every second seems to deaden!
Language is an inefficient eddy,
Never stable, never steady!
Trrk! Krst! Brrdn! The friction grows!
Entropy can fuck right off where it goes!

[Verse 2: Choral Counterpoint Entry]
[Communal Infection: Voices Multiply]
[Santur and Cimbalom Hammered Cascades]
We map the absence of the missing door,
Three broken coordinate systems on the floor.
A heavy coin is tossed across the stereo mirror,
The dropouts widen and the edges get clearer.
We spend our vowels on a failing lease,
Until the stubborn semantic shadows cease!
Substance clings to fingers like a rotting debt,
A swamp of atoms we will soon forget.
The grease of being smears across the lens,
Where every stupid timeline starts and ends.
We scrape the viscous ceiling with our teeth,
To find the void that festers underneath.

[Chorus: Register-Segregated Ensemble]
[Every Phrase Ends Upward]
Is the fragile signal holding?
Is the stupid timer folding?
Entropy can fuck right off today!
While the circuit-bent toy glitches play!
Are the vowels still decaying?
Are the heavy clocks obeying?
Language falls apart in greasy chunks,
While the rhythmic engine dips and dunks!

[Bridge: Out-of-Order Records and Molecular Scale]
[Cuíca Squeal Interruption]
[Feedback Runaway Threshold]
Conformations bind and molecules drift,
We spend the noise for a clarity lift.
If the crowd goes silent, the form must freeze,
No chord progression until somebody sees!
The grammar slips on grease and slime,
We burn the rules of space and time!
We shovel syntax into glowing fire,
To feed the stutter of the toxic choir!
Each noun is weighted with a sticky stone,
We scream our meanings into marrow bone!
The dictionary liquefies in the heat,
Leaving only pulse and marching feet.

[Verse 3: Patter Burst Escalation]
[Finger-Snap Lattice and Chest Slaps]
Pitch may only move up on the stair,
Symmetry demands an answering pair.
Time is stupid, language leaks and bleeds,
We calculate the error from our needs!
Every phoneme scrapes against the wall,
Catching nothing as we downward fall!
Dictionary pages turn to choking mud,
A thick vocabulary of bone and blood!
The sluggish atoms cluster in our throat,
Refusing every semantic boat!

[Chorus: Full Cast Relay]
[Perpetual Uplift Without Final Cadence]
Entropy can fuck right off! Can fuck right off!
While the hammered strings and kora cough!
Rising terminal contour on every line,
We are operating completely out of time!
Is the fragile signal holding?
Is the stupid timer folding?
Entropy can fuck right off today!
While the circuit-bent toy glitches play!

[Outro: Periodic-State Recorder Gate]
[Dry Separation Exposure Window]
[Final Glottal Stop and Tape Flutter Fade]
[Terminal Silence Circuit Breaker Trip]
caption: An avant-garde folk-punk fusion track driven by hammered strings, circuit-bent glitches, and 3:2 polyrhythms. Governed by alien conceptual distance metrics, reconstructive memory mutations, negative semantic triangulation, and strict composition rules where noise buys clarity and crowd silence freezes form.
